                                        ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 8-H in the area bounded by:

              A line 274.7 feet north of and parallel to West 37"'' Street; South Winchester
              Avenue; a line 249.7 feet north of and parallel to West 37* Street; and the public
              alley next west of and parallel to South Winchester Avenue

to those of a RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.



Address: 3632 South Winchester Avenue
